The '''Raddaugh Gnasp fluttercraft''', or '''Wookiee ornithopter''', was a small patrol flier used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:WookieeFluttercraft-SWDB.jpg|thumb|left|The fluttercraft was named after the predatory gnasps of Alaris.]]
The fluttercraft was named after the predatory insects known as [[Gnasp/Legends|gnasps]], which were native to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] colony [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. It was a compact twin-seated scout craft used to patrol the dangerous lower levels of the jungles of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], as well as for rescue missions. The vehicle had no armor and relied on speed and agility to avoid enemy fire, though it was fitted with a rear-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] operated by the vehicle's gunner.

==History==
<div style="float:right">[[File:Catamaran.jpg|thumb|left|A fluttercraft on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].]]</div>

The Raddaugh Gnasp was developed as a civil security patrol vessel, and was commonly used in recon missions and perimeter scans in the dangerous underbrush of Kashyyyk's forests. However, it was pressed into military service during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and saw action during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

Weeks later, they would be employed once more in the defense of the Wookiee homeworld, this time entering into combat against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] under the command of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Many fluttercrafts had been retrofitted with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] following the initial departure of Imperial forces from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. This time, however, the Wookiees did not prevail, and the planet was [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|enslaved]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Gnasp flier, or Wookiee ornithopter, was originally called the dragonfly helicopter during the concept phase. In developing Wookiee technology, it was decided it would be a mixture of finely crafted woodwork and polished tubing that resembled brass instruments.

The Wookiee ornithopter was built as a computer-generated model, but for a closeup shot of its tail gunner, a minimal full-size bluescreen mockup of the vessel's gunner seat was constructed at ILM to house a costumed Wookiee performer.<ref name="DB-Wookiee ornithopter">{{DB|vehicle|gnasp|Wookiee ornithopter}}</ref>
